senses.gloss:
r. 6th cl. (मुरति)
To encircle, to entwine, to bind together.

m. (-रः)
The name of a DAITYA killed by VIṢṆU.
f. (-रा)
A vegetable perfume.
(-रं)
Surrounding, encircling.
E.
मुर to encircle, aff. क, or अङ् and टाप् fem. aff.

f. (-मूः)
Fainting.
E.
मुर्च्छ to faint, aff. क्विप्, and the छ rejected after र.

m. (-जः)
A small drum, a tabor.
f. (-जा)
1 The wife of KUVERA.
2 A large drum.
E.
मुर encircling, with wood, &c., and ज born, made.

m. (-लः)
The jack fruit tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.)

m. (-ण्डः)
A country on the north-west of Hindustan, called also Lampaka, and now Lamgan.
m. plu. (-ण्डाः)
The inhabitants of Lamgan.

m. (-दः)
The conch of VIṢṆU.
E.
मुर a demon, दो to cut, (to alarm,) aff. ड.

f. (-ला)
The Narmadā river.

m. (-ण्डः)
Pimples on the face.

m. (-पुः)
A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU.
E.
मुर the demon, and रिपु enemy.

f. (-ला)
The Narmadā river.

f. (-ली)
A flute, a pipe.
E.
मुर surrounding, ला to get or have, aff. क and ङीष्.

m. (-रः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
मुरली a flute, and धर who holds.

m. (-हा)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
मुर the demon, and हन् slayer.

m. (-रिः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
मुर the demon, and अरि the foe.

(आ) मुर्च्छा r. 1st cl. (मूर्च्छति)
1 To be faint, to lose consciousness or perception.
2 To increase, to grow.

f. (-र्च्छा)
Fainting, loss of consciousness or sense.
E.
मुर्च्छा to be faint, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

f. (-णी)
A small fire place or fire pan.

m. (-रः)
1 A name of KĀMA or CUPID.
2 A fire of chaff.
3 One of the horses of the sun.

(ई) मुर्व्वी r. 1st cl. (मुर्वति)
To bind, to tie.

f. (-र्व्वा-र्व्वी)
A sort of creeper, from the fibres of which bowstrings are made, (Sanseviera zeylanica); they should also form the girdle worn by the Kṣatriya class.
E.
मुर्व्व to bind, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-र्खः-र्खा-र्खं)
Foolish, ignorant, stupid, idiotic.
m. (-र्खः)
A sort of bean, (Phaseolus radiatus.)
E.
मूर्ख substituted for मुह to be foolish, aff. अच्, or मुर substituted for the root, with ख Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
The brother of a fool.
E.
मूर्ख a fool, भ्रातृ a brother, and कप् aff.

mfn. (-र्च्छन्-र्च्छन्ती-र्च्छत्)
Fainting, swooning.
E.
मुर्च्छ to faint, शतृ aff.

nf. (-नं-ना)
1 Fainting, syncope, swooning.
2 Mixing, meeting.
3 A tone or semitone as placed in its scale, the seventh part of a Grāma or scale.
4 Calcining quicksilver with sulphur, &c.
E.
मुर्च्छ to faint, to become insensible, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Fainted, fainting, insensible.
E.
मूर्च्छा fainting, (the act,) and लच् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Faint.
E.
मूर्च्छा, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Fainting, fainted, insensible.
2 Stupid, ignorant.
3 Tall, lofty.
4 Grown, increased, augmented.
E.
मुर्च्छ to be faint, to grow or increase, &c., aff. क्त, or मूर्च्छा as above, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Bound, tied.
E.
मुर्व्व to bind, aff. क्त; form irr.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
1 Fainting, fainted, losing sense or consciousness.
2 Solid, material, endowed with form or shape.
E.
मुर्च्छ to lose consciousness, aff. क्त, form irr.

f. (-र्त्तिः)
1 Matter, substance, solidity.
2 The body.
3 Figure, form, body in general, or any definite shape or image.
E.
मुर्च्छ to faint, to become insensible, aff. क्तिन्, form irr.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
1 Material, substantial, having shape or substance.
2 Incarnate.
n. (-मत्)
The body.
E.
मूर्त्ति shape, &c., मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-कः)
The man of the second or military class.
E.
मूर्द्ध the head, and कन् aff.

f. (-री)
An umbrella, or inverted basket carried on the head for the same purpose.
E.
मूर्द्धं the head, कर्प्पर a sort of pan, and ङीष् aff.

n. (-लं)
A sort of umbrella: see the last.
E.
मूर्द्ध the head, खोल or खोलक a helmet.

m. (-जः)
Hair, the hair of the head.
E.
मूर्द्ध the head, and ज born.

m. (-र्द्धा)
The head.
E.
मुह to be foolish, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, form irr., or मुर्व्व to bind, the same aff., धङ् augment.

m. (-ष्पः)
A tree, commonly Siris, (Mimosa sirisha.)
E.
मूर्द्धं the head, and पुष्प flower.

m. (-सः)
The scum of boiled rice, &c.
E.
मूर्द्ध head, top, and रस juice.

n. (-नं)
A turban, a fillet, a diadem, &c.
E.
मूर्द्ध the head, and वेष्टन surrounding.

m. (-क्तः)
1 A man of the second or military class, the Kṣatriya or soldier.
2 A king, a prince.
3 A chief minister, a counsellor of state.
4 The name of a mixed class, sprung from a Brahman, and female of the second or Kṣatriya tribe; the principal of the mixed races, and soldier by profession.
E.
मूर्द्ध the head, and अभिषिक्त sprinkled, anointed; kings being consecrated by having poured on their heads, while seated on a throne prepared for the purpose, water from some sacred stream, mixed with honey, clarified butter, and spirituous liquor, as well as two sorts of grass and the sprouts of corn: the term applies to the Kṣatriya as identified with the king, the duties of royalty, belonging especially, to the military caste.

m. (-र्द्ध्वा)
1 The head.
2 The base, (in geometry.)
E.
मुर्व्व to bind, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, and ध्वङ् substituted for the radical final.
